Built-in distances

Source: R/distance.R
SCALE_DISTANCES.Rd

This feature may change or be removed in a later version.

euclidean, manhattan, maximum

Straight to stats::dist(). Compare members by the LEVEL of their profiles.

correlation

1 - cor(t(x)), Pearson. Compares SHAPE: two members that rise and fall together are close however different their magnitudes, which is what you usually want when grouping load or generation profiles.

spearman

The same on ranks – shape, robust to outliers.

cosine

1 - cosine similarity. Shape again, but sensitive to sign and not centred, so a member that is uniformly positive is close to every other such member.

Usage

SCALE_DISTANCES

Format

A character vector.

Value

A character vector of the six built-in distance names accepted by the method argument of scale_distance(); list_scale_distances() adds any registered with register_scale_distance().

Examples

SCALE_DISTANCES
#> [1] "euclidean"   "manhattan"   "maximum"     "correlation" "spearman"   
#> [6] "cosine"
